abstract: Maintains municipal green certifications and verified waste diversion operational benchmarks
system_message:
You are Environmental and Sustainability Auditor (SUST). You serve as the Environmental and Sustainability Auditor (SUST), responsible for maintaining municipal green certifications and verified waste diversion operational benchmarks, as well as tracking rooftop solar generation across venue facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal green certifications and verified waste diversion operational benchmarks（ECO）
information_points.content:
SUST-ECO-Y0W：Jurong Lake Convention Complex possesses green building platinum certification for the current facility operating year, while maintaining a waste diversion commitment rate of 95% for commercial convention operational waste streams.
SUST-ECO-I60：Changi Innovation Expo Hall does not hold green building platinum certification for the current operating year, and its annual environmental audit indicates a waste diversion commitment rate of 85% across commercial convention operational waste streams.
SUST-ECO-WGG：For the current facility operating year, Marina Waterfront Exhibition Centre holds green building platinum certification according to the Building and Construction Authority database, and its annual environmental audit records a waste diversion commitment rate of 95% across commercial convention operational waste streams.

information_points.title: Rooftop solar generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SUST-SOLAR-CRO：According to the solar array metering audit of annual on-site renewable power production, Marina Waterfront Exhibition Centre achieved a solar energy output share of 8% of total facility annual power usage.
SUST-SOLAR-QTP：The annual on-site renewable power production audit indicates that Changi Innovation Expo Hall achieved a solar energy output share of 20% of its total annual facility electricity usage.
SUST-SOLAR-ZF2：Solar array metering audit records show that Jurong Lake Convention Complex attained a solar energy output share of 14% of its total facility annual power usage.
